title: Diarrhoea
summary: Replace fluids first, then eat light
ayurvedicView: Loose motions are linked to Pitta and weak digestive fire. Replacing lost fluids comes first; light, binding foods help recovery.
remedies: Oral rehydration solution (ORS) after every loose stool; this matters most
Thin buttermilk with a pinch of roasted jeera and salt
Soft khichdi, rice with curd, and ripe banana
A little fresh pomegranate (anar) or its juice
Isabgol (psyllium husk) stirred into curd to firm the stools once the first day has passed
prevention: Drink safe, boiled or filtered water
Wash hands before eating and after using the toilet
Eat freshly cooked food and avoid street food that has stood out
tips: Keep drinking even if you are not hungry
Avoid milk, fried food and very sweet drinks until better
seeDoctor: Signs of dehydration: very little urine, dizziness, a dry mouth, or a baby with a sunken soft spot
Blood in the stool, or high fever
Diarrhoea lasting more than two days in an adult or one day in a child
Any diarrhoea in a baby under six months, an older person, or someone with a long-term illness
